You are the **SCORER** for COMMIT 4 — the commit that puts the Zimmermann layout on the PDP, and the last gate before a **developer acceptance check on a live page**. Fresh and independent. READ-ONLY on the repo; probes outside it (`/tmp`) are fine, including real deletions there.

Repo: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa` @ `57cd0b9` + 3 modified files. Three commits landed; COMMIT 1's live-PDP check passed.

# ⚠️ Harness traps that have produced false results in this loop

1. **Stale Storybook on `127.0.0.1:6006`** (since Friday, broken index). `test-storybook`'s default `--url` is exactly that. **Never run it bare.**
2. **`cr review --base develop` reads STAGED state**, not the worktree. Use `--uncommitted`.
3. **`tsc` does not catch a typo'd Chakra responsive key** — `paddingTop={{ notAValidToken: 1 }}` type-checks clean. If you probe whether tsc is live, use an **undeclared identifier**, not a bad token.
4. **axe (G4) does not flag `aria-labelledby` pointing at a nonexistent id** in this config. `image-alt` does fail — use that to prove the gate live.

# The change — 3 files

`git diff HEAD`. `pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (147 lines: COMMIT 4's whole in-tree work), plus `zimmProductPrice/index.tsx` and its test (an authorised path-set expansion for an a11y fix).

**What COMMIT 4 does:** restores the SFCC-89 block that COMMIT 1 stripped out, across 12 sites in 7 rows, plus four deliberate changes — the `<Stack>` wrapper replaced by `ZimmProductMeta`, D17's skeleton `minHeight`, D18's bundle price gate, and one inert cast deleted. Then one rework round fixed two tester findings.

# Gates — MEASURED by me. Do not re-run.

| Gate | Required | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| G1 tsc | 0 | **0** |
| G2 vitest | 363 + A(1) / 24 | **364 / 24** |
| G3 lint | 17 err / 15 warn | **17 / 15** |
| G4 storybook | 102 / 23 | **23 suites passed** (rebuilt — the price atom is in the story graph, so the static shortcut was void) |
| G5 audit:tokens | 14 / 22 | **14 / 22** (structurally immovable — `pages/**` is outside `SCAN_ROOTS`) |
| G7 CodeRabbit | must run | **0 findings, 3 files** |

# What the tester found, and what happened

**DEFECT-1 (fixed this round).** The meta block rendered **92px** below the panels against a 28px design spec. Cause: `pages/product-detail/index.tsx:802` is `<Stack spacing={16}>` — Chakra spaces with `gap`, `space[16]` = 4rem = 64px — and `<Island>` emits no DOM element (`partialHydrationEnabled: false`), so the molecule was a direct flex item: 64 + its own 28px. **This was my error** — I made "delete the old `<Stack spacing="l" paddingTop="l">` wrapper" the commit's headline instruction without checking the parent. It fixed one hop (20→28px) and worsened the other (84→92px).

Fix, on the developer's ruling: `<InformationAccordion/>` and `<ZimmProductMeta/>` now share one `<Box>`, so the pair is a single flex item.

**Builder's probe (headless Chromium, real ancestor chain reproduced): panels below ProductView 64px unchanged · panels → model line 92px → 28px · pair → rail 64px unchanged.** It reproduced the 92px before the fix, which is what makes the after-numbers credible. **Verify this independently — it is the single most important claim in the commit, and a probe is not the real page.**

**DEFECT-2 (no action, correctly).** `longDescription` renders twice — once in the header, once in base's still-mounted "Product Detail" accordion panel. Present in the pre-split original too, so not a restore error. This is **open item (b), which the developer explicitly scoped out of SFCC-89.** Do not re-raise it as a defect; confirm only that it is what it is.

**DEFECT-3 (half fixed, half deferred on the developer's ruling).** Base's `DisplayPrice` gave master products a `From {price}` prefix and carried `aria-label` + a `VisuallyHidden aria-live` region. The a11y half was fixed; `From` is deferred to SFCC-194 with the was/now work and will be declared in the PR body.

# Rule on these specifically

**(a) The `<Box>` fix — verify all three gaps yourself.** Panels' position unchanged, molecule at 28px, rail unchanged. Then ask what the probe cannot: does anything else depend on `InformationAccordion` being a direct flex child? Does the new `<Box>` change stacking, hydration boundaries, or anything `<Island>` does?

**(b) Two structural deviations in the a11y fix — I accepted both; test my ruling.**
1. `aria-live`/`aria-atomic` sit **on the price element** rather than in a `VisuallyHidden` sibling. Forced: the sibling version failed G4 because `zimmProductContent/index.stories.tsx`'s `play` asserts **exact child count**, and fixing that needs a file outside the authorised path set. Claimed better anyway — base needs its second node only to order a `labelForA11y` name ahead of the price (base's own comment), which nothing supplies here.
2. **`aria-label` omitted entirely.** Claimed reason: base's exists to prepend localised words; our atom takes a pre-formatted price, has no `useIntl`, and there is no `useIntl` precedent in `ui-kits/`. English-only across 11 locales would be an i18n defect; a label duplicating visible text is a no-op or a double-read.

**Does the shipped form actually satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA 4.1.3?** That is the question — not whether it matches base. Consider whether `aria-live` on an element whose text React mutates in place genuinely announces, and whether `aria-atomic` is right.

**(c) The restore, once more.** 12 sites in 7 rows against `git show sfcc-89-wip:overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`. The tester verified completeness; look for the harder failure it might have missed — a site restored with a *different* value, an inverted conditional, an added or lost `?.`.

**(d) THE G6 CHECKLIST — your last job, and it goes to a human.** The tester drafted one. **Sanity-check and correct it.** Specifically confirm or refute each of these, because a wrong item wastes the developer's time or hides a defect:
- the meta block does **not** collapse on a loaded product, because `styleCode = product.master?.masterId ?? product.id` is always present — so it renders with the style code alone, and the **model line will not appear at all** (`c_modelFit` is unpopulated across the dev catalogue)
- clicking a size swatch must **not** change the style code (it is the master's, not the variant SKU)
- the header block appears **twice in view-source** (mobile + desktop wrappers, one hidden by `display`) — base does the same
- an **empty breadcrumb renders with no skeleton shimmer**, because `category` is `[]` which is truthy — base-verbatim
- **set and bundle PDPs still show the OLD base header** — `renderHeader` is wired only to the standard-product `ProductView`
- **D18 cannot be exercised on any live PDP** — `isProductPartOfBundle` is always `false` at that one site
- a hard refresh may show **no loading state at all** (SSR-prefetched); navigate from a PLP link to see it

# How to score

- Per axis PASS/REWORK against the five authorities (ticket · Figma · docs · PR #59 · token/component/CSS/override structure), `file:line` **plus anchor text** for any defect.
- Overall PASS only if every axis passes and every gate matches.
- **State what you tried to falsify — mandatory, including at least one "delete it and re-run".** Every genuinely valuable finding in this loop came from a deletion, not a reading.
- **Treat every orchestrator claim as CLAIMED.** Ten of my assertions have been caught wrong in this loop, including the one that caused DEFECT-1.
- Don't re-litigate settled decisions: 28px as a named const, `useUiCopy` removed, breadcrumb kept, description duplication scoped out, `From` deferred, no page story.

# Output

1. Per-axis verdict table.
2. **Overall: PASS or REWORK.**
3. Rulings on (a), (b), (c).
4. **The corrected G6 checklist**, as its own section, ready to hand to the developer.
5. What you tried to falsify.
6. If PASS: the biggest residual risk, and anything COMMIT 5 must carry.
